header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon Additional A.G Sindh.
Mr. Ghulam Abbas Dalwani Deputy Prosecutor General.
Mr. Danyal Ali Qureshi, Advocate files Vakalatnama on behalf of the
body: respondents, taken on record. None is present on behalf of the petitioner. Same was the position on last date of hearing. Record reflects that after the last date of hearing, no efforts have been made to proceed with the matter, which shows that counsel for the petitioner is not interested. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
